assumptions: Origin 2026-09 (last full Eurostat release). Target: Dec 2026 YoY at h=3.
Item weights 2026 (published); no new annual weights enter before January.
Fuels: Weekly Oil Bulletin Mondays known by 14 Oct 2026: 05 Oct, 12 Oct; later weeks held flat at the last price.
No Brent futures bridge: pump prices beyond the last bulletin are a no-change assumption.
Fan: empirical quantiles of the backtest's own out-of-sample errors per horizon (200 origins from 2010-01), centred on the point forecast.
